annotations.text: Option A · Quiet. Closest to Nikoli. One rule line, a hairline running head, the grid as the only object on the page. Tradeoff: little room for the morning-ritual framing (day, time, notes).
Option B · Morning page. Built around the ritual: Day number, Japanese name, started/finished fields and a notes rule. Tradeoff: busiest page; the grid is 500 px instead of 540 px.
Option C · Editorial. Asymmetric. Big numeral, running head turned up the spine, grid pushed to the outer edge where the thumb lands. Tradeoff: boldest identity, least conventional for a puzzle book.

Second row: Option A applied to Nurikabe and Shikaku to show one system carrying several genres, plus a solutions page at six per page. All pages are 7 × 10 in (672 × 960 px at 96 px/in), black ink only, recto pages with a 0.75 in gutter. Puzzles shown are layout samples: valid structures, not yet verified for a unique solution.
